catalogs.name: Classic console indexes
catalogs.description: Searchable title and remote box-art references across 17 classic console feeds. Each platform points to its own source index.
catalogs.mode: Indexed by platform; image URLs stay on their original hosts

catalogs.name: Steam Store
catalogs.description: A refreshed top-seller snapshot plus title-specific store records, including header art, gameplay screenshots, and store backgrounds.
catalogs.mode: Scheduled snapshot; the app reads published metadata and image URLs

catalogs.name: Wikidata + Wikimedia Commons
catalogs.description: Searches game records and Commons files for modern-console platform links, covers, logos, gameplay images, icons, title screens, and wallpapers.
catalogs.mode: Live title search; every result keeps its record or file page

catalogs.name: Publisher press pages
catalogs.description: Publisher pages can be added per game to the same index. Configured feeds are parsed into original and preview URLs; current automated press-page coverage is listed below.
catalogs.mode: Per-title adapter; no UI rewrite when another compatible page is added

catalogs.name: SteamGridDB
catalogs.description: Live per-title API search for grids, heroes, logos, and icons. Previews stay on SteamGridDB-hosted image URLs; Rupa does not copy the image files or infer reuse rights.
catalogs.mode: Worker API search; remote image references

catalogs.name: LaunchBox Games Database
catalogs.description: External title search for game metadata and image editions across systems.

catalogs.name: The Cover Project
catalogs.description: Community cover scans for console games, linked as an external reference catalog.

catalogs.name: Reddit search
catalogs.description: Title-specific community search. Rupa links to the results page; it does not scrape login-gated posts.

catalogs.name: Imgur search
catalogs.description: Title-specific community search; image pages remain hosted by Imgur.
